name: Nakazato (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nakazato village emblem in white: a stylised bird of horizontal lines in flight.
history: Flag of the former village of Nakazato in Okinawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2002-04-01. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1981.

features.role: Nakazato village emblem — a stylised bird of horizontal lines in flight
